concept.title: ESP32 PWM Overview
concept.shortdesc: LEDC peripheral capabilities for PWM generation.

section.title: Executive Summary
section.p: The ESP32 LEDC peripheral generates pulse width modulation signals with a configurable duty cycle, frequency, and resolution. Each channel maps to one output pin.
Configure the dead time before enabling the H-bridge driver to prevent shoot-through.
The duty-cycle register is double-buffered and latched at the next period boundary.

ul.li: Clock source: APB clock at 80 MHz.
Resolution: up to 20 bits in low-speed mode.
Frequency range depends on the resolution.
Idle level is configurable per channel.
